name: pcre2
description: Perl-compatible regular expression library supporting 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit character encodings, with optional Unicode and JIT support.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
